verdict.line: You lose if you let Camille chain Q into E engages onto you for free; you win if you dodge or punish her all-in with E.

brief.thesis: Camille's entire kill threat is her E (Hookshot) engage chained into Q (Precision Protocol) burst, and Jax's E (Counter Strike) is a hard counter to that exact pattern — a stunned Camille mid-dive gets none of her follow-up damage. This is why Jax sits at 51.3% over 3142 games despite Camille holding the lane-advantage tag: her tools are high-commitment and Jax punishes commitment harder than most tops.

theirWindow.when: Camille's E and Q both up
theirWindow.what: She can wall-jump onto you with E (Hookshot, 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown) for the knockup, then land a Q (Precision Protocol) auto for bonus damage and move speed. If she lands the knockup clean before you can react, this is her most dangerous trade.

yourWindow.what: Hold E (Counter Strike) until she's committed to the wall jump animation, then pop it the instant she lands — the stun shuts down her Q follow-up and auto-reset entirely, and you get the full stun damage on her. This is the OP.GG-confirmed line: dodge or punish the dive, don't trade into it.

runes.keystoneWhy: The 50.4% win rate page built around attack speed scaling matches how Jax wants to fight Camille — stack autos through her Q window and punish her for standing still after a failed E dive.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is both the highest win rate (51.2%) and by far the most-picked combo (68.5%) — Ignite punishes her all-in commitment the same way your E does, denying the sustain from her passive shield and W healing if she dives and you land the stun.

playing.title: Bait the E dive, don't walk into it
playing.detail: Stand slightly out of her E (Hookshot, 800 range) threat range near walls so she has to commit fully to reach you — the longer her dash is in flight, the more time you have to see it and hold your E (Counter Strike) for the landing.

playing.title: Stun on landing, not on approach
playing.detail: Your E (Counter Strike) only stuns when she's in range on landing — pop it too early during her dash and you waste the 18/16/14/12/10s cooldown on nothing.

playing.title: Track her Q charge state
playing.detail: Precision Protocol (Q) can be recast for bonus damage if she delays between hits — if you see her land the first Q and back off instead of following up immediately, she's baiting the delayed recast; don't stand still.

playing.title: Use W before all-in autos
playing.detail: Pop W (Empower, 7/6/5/4/3s cooldown) into your next auto or Leap Strike right as you land your E stun — this is your single highest damage window in the trade.

playing.title: Hold R until the fight is committed
playing.detail: Relentless Assault (R) has no cooldown and only matters once attacks are landing — don't pre-activate it before she dives, save the attack-speed ramp for when autos are actually connecting.

playing.title: Avoid trading into her W poke pre-6
playing.detail: Tactical Sweep (W, 610 range) slows and heals her if you're caught in the outer half — don't walk forward to trade autos when her W is up, let her burn it on a poke instead of a stun setup.

playing.title: Respect R only from level 6
playing.detail: The Hextech Ultimatum (R, 140/115/90/0/0s cooldown, 475 range) anchors you in place from level 6 on — don't overextend past minion wave once she's level 6 even if her E and Q are down, since R alone can lock you into a 1v1 she wants.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, boots, and summoner spells above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG win-rate data on the current patch; the trade timing, stun-punish reasoning, and power-curve calls are my own tactical read of the kit interactions.

stats.opponentTip: Use Counter Strike [E] when Camille closes in using Wall Dive (E) to stop her from dealing additional damage. You will have the upper hand if you manage to stun her.
